fields.description: Issue includes investigative and editorial coverage alleging connections between Rev. Joseph Barth of the First Unitarian Church and psychiatrist T. Earl Moore, including reproduction of a letter and discussion of a former patient’s suicide. Also reports on renewed proposals for Dade County/city consolidation, a major oil well discovery in the Sunniland field, commentary on Gov. Fuller Warren, local court and crime items, legal notices, and community features and advertisements (including entertainment and racing).
